name: Orbclo Dev Orbit
author: onisY
description: Refine yearly holiday-cache retention. The active calendar region keeps only the real current year and next year as persistent 46-byte bitsets. Pages scrolled outside that two-year window still calculate only the visible 35 days transiently and do not save a yearly cache. Crucially, switching country/region no longer deletes the previous region's files: inactive Japan/England-Wales/Scotland/Northern-Ireland caches remain in Storage. Add a Holiday cache settings submenu showing per-region file counts and confirmed manual deletion for each region or all caches. RAM remains a separate two-entry decoded working cache.
